text: Artificial intelligence is changing the world very quickly. AI systems are used in healthcare, finance, education, and transportation.
Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence. ML algorithms learn patterns from data and can make predictions.
Natural language processing helps computers understand human language. NLP is used in chatbots, translation systems, and text analysis.
Deep learning uses neural networks with many layers. It is widely used for image recognition, speech recognition, and complex prediction tasks.
Computer vision allows machines to analyze images and video. AI systems can detect objects, recognize faces, and classify visual information.
Data science combines statistics, programming, and machine learning. It helps companies analyze large amounts of data and make better decisions.
